verdict.rationale: RustDesk's own llms.txt says the remote desktop client is AGPL-licensed and the OSS server is open source. The GitHub README tells users to clone the repository and build it. A community member's comments on the code's style independently show the source is publicly readable. missing for 10: an open license covering the commercial Server Pro components, and direct citation of the repository's LICENSE file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: RustDesk provides an AGPL-licensed remote desktop client and OSS server
Server OSS: a free, open-source ID/rendezvous server (hbbs) and relay server (hbbr) that you can deploy on your own infrastructure.
Begin by cloning the repository and building the Docker container
